::: {#exm-cartesian-product-menu}
#### Cartesian products

- The choices in @exr-menu are the Cartesian product
  $\set{\text{rye}, \text{wheat}} \times \set{\text{ham}, \text{cheese}, \text{tomato}}$ (@def-cartesian-product).
- $\set{\text{ham}, \text{cheese}, \text{tomato}} \times \set{\text{rye}, \text{wheat}}$
  is a different set: it holds $(\text{ham}, \text{rye})$, which is not $(\text{rye}, \text{ham})$ (@exm-tuple).
- $\reals \times \reals$ is the set of points $(x, y)$ in the plane.
- Adding a choice of drink gives $3$-tuples (@def-cartesian-product-many), such as
  $(\text{rye}, \text{ham}, \text{tea}) \in \set{\text{rye}, \text{wheat}} \times \set{\text{ham}, \text{cheese}, \text{tomato}} \times \set{\text{tea}, \text{juice}}$.

:::
